items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: He made the summer on there one summer, way back in 19, in the 20s

ctx.x: Do you remember, uh, Leon Rapolo, a clarinet player? That's the one I'm talking about. He was on the boat. He was on the boat. Oh, yes.
He made the summer on there one summer, way back in 19, in the 20s, I think, in the 28s, 20s, or 20s.

I saw Santopocor on here the night that, uh, Turk Murphy was here. And they had the, uh, Columbia recording people here. I think he was, huh? Santo, I know. He played with that band. And then there was a fellow called George Bernice that played trombone with him, too. He's from a musical family. I thought maybe you remember George.
